summary.text: Jim Minnix is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 118 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jim Minnix graduated from Scott Community High School in 1972, earned a degree from Colby Community College in 1974, a B.S. in agricultural economics from Kansas State University in 1977, a B.S. in business finance in 1978, and an M.B.A. from Kansas State University in 1980.
He cofounded the Scott Community Foundation and served as a community leader with 4-H.
Minnix took office representing Kansas House District 118 on January 11, 2021, succeeding Don Hineman.
In the 2025–2026 session he chaired the Water Committee and was assigned to the Agriculture Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
